description: A chat's queue changed (a change to the chat: Agent Management's write): messages added at its end, dropped by id, or the one up to which it's sent as the turn ends named. Told every other head attached to it (queue_changed). Sent on the chat's own connection, so it's in order with the interrupt send-now asks for.

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

add.description: Messages queued, at its end (one whose id it has already: left as it is).

drop.description: The ids of messages taken out of it (sent by the head, edited, deleted).

upto.description: The id of the one whose send-now stops the turn: it and those before it sent as the turn ends (at once if none's going).
